values: Original-ball paths in Teichmüller space: an elementary corollary of Lenzhen–Rafi. Accepted scope: Each fixed closed genus g>=2 has c_g so every pair in any original closed Teichmuller ball admits an in-ball path of length <= ambient distance+4c_g, giving every fixed k detour bound. Limits: No gap asserted for fixed closed genus; numerical c_g, uniform-in-genus and punctured variants not claimed. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness remain unestablished. Extensive AI use; unrefereed; 2 fresh complete AI package reviews, latest zero actionable issues; no conventional human peer review or formal certification.
